name: Sera Vantis
role: Sylvan warden of the Mirewood's western reach. Joins A1-C2 with her kestrel Burr. Romanceable. Personal quest **The Last Silverbark** (A1-C7)
look: Sera Vantis: Sylvan (a long-lived fantasy people with long, pointed ears), about 140; looks late twenties. Porcelain skin; fine oval face, high cheekbones, narrow nose, composed unsmiling mouth; clear green eyes under straight, elegant honey brows. Long pointed Sylvan ears. Honey-blonde hair in one long braid brought over the left shoulder to the waist. Faint squint-lines from weather. Collar: moss-green ranger's coat with a stand collar and thin cream piping over an oatmeal shirt; short dark-moss-green wool shoulder cape, hood down, fastened with a wooden toggle; undyed-leather quiver strap across the chest; the longbow's tip rising past the right shoulder. Keep their signature colours clear: moss green, undyed leather.

name: Mira Ashgrove
role: Human archivist-healer from Orrin's Reach, Maleficio's old apprentice (she read the Box's lid aloud). Joins A1-C3 (Thornbridge). Romanceable. Personal quest **The Ember Index** (A1-C7 to A1-C8)
look: Mira Ashgrove: human, 26. Fair skin, a dusting of freckles; soft rounded face, rounded cheeks, small kind mouth; gentle brown eyes under softly worried copper brows. Copper hair twisted into a messy bun with a pen pushed through it, loose strands at the temples; an ink smudge on one cheekbone. Collar: cream blouse with full sleeves under a fitted ink-blue laced waistcoat-bodice with dark-blue piping; the broad brown strap of a battered satchel across the chest, capped scroll tubes showing at one shoulder. Keep their signature colours clear: ink blue, parchment.

variants.when: An echo of Mira at thirteen.
variants.change: change the look: round child's face, copper hair in two plaits, oversized parchment smock with ink-blue cuffs. An echo from the past: paint her solid and in full colour; the game tints echoes.

name: Kael Duskmantle
role: Emberkin thief from Tallow Lane in the Low Ring. Joins A1-C4 (the Vault). Romanceable. Personal quest **A Name on a Door** (A1-C7). Can turn and become the Protectorate's Shadow, an Act 3 boss
look: Kael Duskmantle: Emberkin (a fantasy people with horns that sweep back from the temples), 23. Warm tan skin; narrow, sharp-featured face, high cheekbones, thin nose; keen, narrowed amber eyes under angled black brows; one corner of the mouth lifted in a knowing half-smile; clean-shaven. A charcoal hood worn up, ending in a soft point, shading the edge of his face; two dark, ridged horns sweep back from the temples through the hood, pale like old ivory at the tips; black locks escape at the brow. Collar: close-fitting dark leather coat in layered panels, straps and buckles across the chest; charcoal half-cloak; a thin ember-red cord at the throat echoing his sash. Keep their signature colours clear: charcoal, ember red.

variants.when: Act 3, if Kael joins the Protectorate.
variants.change: change the look: hood down, short messy black hair; finer black leathers with violet piping, a long high-collared black coat, a violet sash with a gold crown badge, a black leather half-mask pulled down round the neck; colder eyes.

name: Brannock Ironvein
role: Stoneborn former captain of the Royal Guard who held Greywatch's gate with forty men. Joins A1-C4 (the Rusty Anvil). Not romanceable. Personal quest **Forty Letters** (A1-C7).
look: Brannock Ironvein: Stoneborn (a short, very broad, sturdy mountain people), nearly 200; looks about 55, build stout. Golden-tan weathered skin; craggy lined face, deep-set brown eyes with crow's feet under thick, fierce copper brows; crooked, once-broken nose with an old pale scar across the bridge; a nick through one brow; firm weathered mouth. Short tight copper curls. Full copper beard and moustache in one thick braid down the chest, bound with two tarnished-gold clasps. Thick neck, heavy shoulders. Collar: charcoal padded work shirt, chain-mail shirt, battered iron breastplate edged in tarnished gold, one heavy iron pauldron on the left shoulder. Keep their signature colours clear: iron grey, tarnished gold.
mood: gruff, steady, kind but hides it

variants.change: change the look: the beard braid hangs loose with no clasps; everything else the same.
change the look: his left arm in a plain linen sling across his chest; everything else the same.

name: Valencia Morvaine
role: Dawnborn vampire, Severin's daughter, who hid forty years as Sister Vale at Saint Lumen's Abbey. Joins A2-C2. Romanceable. Personal quest **The Willing** (saving Sister Orla, Act 2)
look: Valencia Morvaine: Dawnborn vampire (born, not turned), of Morvaine, 68; looks 25. Porcelain skin, cool and bloodless; heart-shaped face, small pointed chin; sharp, bright grey eyes under arched silver brows; one corner of the mouth lifted as if about to tease. Long, straight silver hair under a slender silver circlet with a tiny dark-red stone. Fangs hidden at rest. Collar: bone-white gown with a very high, stiff standing collar that frames the jaw, thin wine-red trim on the seams; a long charcoal-black cape lined in wine red over both shoulders. Keep their signature colours clear: bone white, wine red.

variants.change: change the look: a stiff, square-cornered grey hood worn up with a white linen band, hiding all her hair and shading her eyes; grey wool habit with a white linen collar; a small carved wooden bee on a cord.
change the look: the habit without its hood, silver hair loose, eyes red.

variants.when: An echo of Valencia at about eight.
variants.change: change the look: silver hair straight to the shoulders, a plain dark-blue dress with a white collar. An echo from the past: paint her solid and in full colour; the game tints echoes.

name: Princess Elara Aurelian
role: Leon's only child and heir. Ally from A1-C4 (hooded in the Gilded Flagon), leads the resistance in Act 3, crowned at A3-C5-06. Not romanceable and no personal quest of her own; she has an arc, a part in The Heron's Due, and teaches Crownsworn
look: Princess Elara Aurelian: human (the Aurelian royal line), 24. Fair skin; fine oval face, high cheekbones, narrow nose, composed unsmiling mouth; clear, cool grey eyes under straight, elegant black brows. Black hair, long and pinned back at the nape for riding with a few strands loose, under a slim gold circlet with a small sapphire at the brow. Collar: a fitted deep royal-blue riding coat with a high collar trimmed in sun gold and a double row of small gold buttons; a white shirt at the throat; a short royal-blue cape over the left shoulder only, fastened with a gold sun-shaped clasp. Keep their signature colours clear: royal blue, sun gold.

variants.when: Act 1, Chapter 4, in the Gilded Flagon.
variants.change: change the look: a deep charcoal wool hood pulled forward with the upper face in shadow, a plain charcoal waistcoat over a white shirt, a plain charcoal cloak, no gold anywhere.

change the look: black hair hacked into a short choppy cut, her blue coat muddy and torn with dulled gold, a travelling cloak, Leon's sword across her back with its blue leather grip and small gold sun crossguard over the left shoulder.
change the look: Leon's small plain gold crown with one ruby, a white-and-gold mantle over both shoulders.

name: King Leon
role: King of Fable and Elara's father. Speaks through Acts 1-3; spoke for Brannock forty-one years ago. In furs and ill in Act 3; killed by {sb} at A3-C2-03
look: King Leon: human (Aurelian), early sixties. Fair skin; deeply lined, gentle face, drooping lids over kind grey eyes, bushy silver brows, big nose, hollowed cheeks, thin gentle mouth. Silver hair swept back to the collar and a short, neat silver beard. A small, plain gold crown, a simple band with low points and one ruby at the front. Collar: a broad ermine collar (white fur with small black tips) over a white robe-coat trimmed in sun gold, a gold sash across it; a heavy navy cloak falling behind. Keep their signature colours clear: white, sun gold.

variants.change: change the look: grey-pale, drawn skin; a heavy fur-lined navy-and-white robe with a thick fur collar and a wool blanket round the shoulders; crown still on.

name: Archmage Thessaly Varn
role: Head of the Mages Guild at the Arcanum Spire. Briefs the Doomward mission (A1-C7-02) and guards the Deepvault. Sealed in crystal by {sb} (A3-C2-02), freed at A3-C4-03. Trainer (Guild Battlemage, later Hourwarden)
look: Archmage Thessaly Varn: human, 60. Fair skin; lean, sharp face, deep lines round the mouth, long nose, thin lips pressed together; steady, piercing grey eyes under thin grey brows. Grey hair cropped close to the skull. A single plain steel ear stud. Collar: a short deep-cobalt mantle with a high collar over a cobalt robe, both banded with a plain repeated geometric motif in pale silver thread; a slim book on a chain at the chest. the left hand is missing its ring and little fingers, healed long ago. Keep their signature colours clear: Guild cobalt.

variants.change: change the look: the same, frozen mid-cast inside clear faceted crystal with a cold blue-white sheen, facet edges crossing her face.

name: Captain Roderic Hale
role: Captain of the City Watch: the docks in Act 1, trainer (Watchblade). In Act 3 he serves the Protectorate, and SQ3-Hale can turn him
look: Captain Roderic Hale: human, mid-fifties, build broad. Fair skin; craggy, lined, tired face, deep-set grey eyes with crow's feet under thick, fierce silver brows; crooked nose; an old nick through one brow; firm weathered mouth; silver stubble. An open-faced steel helm with a brass rim and a short, stiff crest of navy horsehair running front to back; silver hair at the temples. Collar: navy Watch coat with brass buttons and a large brass lantern badge over chain mail; a navy cloak fastened at one shoulder with a brass clasp; broad, heavy shoulders. Keep their signature colours clear: Watch navy and brass.

variants.change: change the look: a violet tabard with a gold border and a gold stylised crown over the same navy coat, a violet armband.

name: Commander Aldric Voss
role: Commander at Greywatch, old comrade of Brannock and Leon. Dies holding the inner gate (A1-C6-01); his bier starts Brannock's names (A1-C6-03)
look: Commander Aldric Voss: human, about 65. Fair, weathered skin; craggy lined veteran's face, deep-set sky-blue eyes with crow's feet, thick brows, crooked nose, a nick through one brow; silver hair buzzed to the scalp; silver stubble; a gallows-humour crease at one corner of the mouth. Collar: worn, mismatched, dented steel plate (breastplate and rounded pauldrons) over chain mail and a padded jack; an old campaign cloak in faded brick red, patched and singed. Keep their signature colours clear: steel, faded red.

name: Brenna of Ashfall
role: Leader of Doomward's Ashfall fighters and Varkhul's daughter. Guides the party through the Thornwall (A1-C7-05). Trainer (Ashwalker). SQ3-Ashfall turns her, or you fight her
look: Brenna of Ashfall: human (Doomward), about 40. Peach skin smudged with grey ash across the cheek and brow; an old burn scar along the jaw; lean, strong face, firm jaw, straight nose, set mouth, a small old scar on the chin; level, steady grey eyes under straight dark brows. Dark-brown hair pulled up into a warrior's topknot. Collar: black-dyed leather jerkin over a mail shirt; one old, cracked knight's pauldron on the left shoulder, finer than the rest, its engraved crest worn; a long ash-grey cloak, hood down, ragged and singed. Keep their signature colours clear: ash grey, Doomward black.

variants.change: change the look: a violet sash from the left shoulder to the right hip fixed with a gold crown badge; also her boss look.

name: Sir Corwin Halbeck
role: Commander of the Order of the Gilded Morning, who hunts the Dawnborn in Act 2. Dies (A2-C5-02) or is saved; trainer (Gilded Knight); leads SQ3-Gilded if he lives
look: Sir Corwin Halbeck: human, about 50. Fair skin; square-jawed, steady face, broad straight nose, firm mouth, clean-shaven; level blue eyes under a strong, straight brow. Short silver hair at the temples under an open-faced gilded helm with a tall white plume rising from the crest. Collar: polished steel plate with gold-leaf edging, a small sun engraved on each pauldron; a long white tabard with a large gold sun on the chest; a white cloak edged in gold. Keep their signature colours clear: gold-white.

name: Davin
role: Corwin's squire, who carries Corwin's sword. Leads SQ3-Gilded if Corwin died; trainer (Gilded Knight)
look: Davin: human, about 17. Tan skin; smooth, eager young face, soft jaw not yet filled out, straight nose a little big for it, clean-shaven; wide-open brown eyes. Short, messy dark-brown hair, no helm, no plume. Collar: a mail shirt a little big for him; over it a white tabard with a large gold sun, plainly cut down from a bigger man's and re-hemmed by hand in uneven stitches; the hilt of Corwin's too-big sword at one shoulder. Keep their signature colours clear: gold-white.
mood: earnest, grieving, trying to stand tall

name: Mother Superior Anselle
role: Head of Saint Lumen's Abbey, which sheltered Sister Vale (A2-C2-01). Trainer (Lamplighter)
look: Mother Superior Anselle: human, about 75. Fair skin; soft, round, kindly face with many fine wrinkles, small nose, sweet tired smile; gentle hazel eyes in deep creases. Silver hair in a neat low bun, no hood. Collar: plain grey wool habit with a white linen collar; a small carved wooden bee on a cord round the neck; the top of a heavy iron key ring at the belt. Keep their signature colours clear: grey, white.

name: Sister Orla
role: Saint Lumen's beekeeper and Valencia's willing donor for thirty years. Arrested by the Order in **The Willing**; trainer (Hivekeeper) if saved
look: Sister Orla: human, about 60. Peach skin, freckled and sun-browned; broad, weathered face, apple cheeks, broad nose, wide good-humoured mouth; crinkled blue eyes with deep laugh lines. Silver hair under a wide-brimmed straw hat with a fine honey-coloured mesh bee veil, pinned up at the front and hanging at the back and sides. Collar: brown wool habit, sleeves rolled; a honey-yellow canvas smock-apron over it, sticky at the front; a hive tool on a cord. Keep their signature colours clear: honey yellow, brown.

name: Lady Isadora
role: Severin's late wife and Valencia's mother. Seen only as an echo (A2-C3-03) and through her journal; the journal teaches Glasswright
look: Lady Isadora: a Morvaine noblewoman, about 35, as she was forty years ago. Fair skin; soft, round face, small kind mouth; gentle brown eyes under softly worried brows. Dark-brown hair in a braided updo. Collar: a deep midnight-blue gown with fitted sleeves and a modest square neckline, fine silver embroidery of small night-flowers; a sprig of night-flowers raised near her chin. Keep their signature colours clear: midnight blue.
note: Paint her solid and in full colour; the game tints her as a ghostly echo.

name: Corra
role: {sb}'s mother, a net-mender of Kettle Cove. Speaks in P-03 ("Well. Now you've got each other.") and in her three letters (A1-C7, A2, A3)
look: Corra: human (southern isles), early fifties now; about 36 in the flashback. Tan, salt-weathered skin; broad, weathered face, apple cheeks, broad nose, wide mouth; crinkled grey eyes with deep laugh lines. Chestnut hair, grey at the temples, in a messy bun. Collar: a thick, cove-blue (soft sea-grey blue) knitted shawl round the shoulders, knotted at the front; an oatmeal blouse; a faded blue kerchief at the throat. No ring: she paid it as {sb}'s fine. Keep their signature colours clear: cove blue, oiled brown.

variants.when: The Prologue's flashback, sixteen years younger.
variants.change: change the look: a lean, strong face with a small chin scar; chestnut hair loose and soaked by rain; the same shawl dark with water.

name: Maleficio
role: The Doomward council scholar who fed the famine children, then took the Box. Mira's teacher. Act 1's villain; boss at A1-C8-02 (the Sovereign), then the Hungering
look: Maleficio: human, about 70. Fair skin; deeply lined, gentle face, drooping lids over kind brown eyes, bushy silver brows, big nose, hollowed cheeks, thin gentle mouth. Silver hair receding from a high forehead; a short, neat silver beard. Collar: long, layered charcoal scholar's robes with a tall, stiff, fan-shaped collar rising behind the head; the collar's edge and the hems glow faintly ember orange, like paper just starting to burn; a dark sash with archivist's keys; a faint ember underglow on the chin from the Box floating below. Keep their signature colours clear: charcoal, ember orange.

variants.when: An echo of the teacher Mira knew.
variants.change: change the look: dark-brown hair, a short dark beard, a firmer veteran's face, plain brown-and-charcoal scholar's robes with the sleeves pushed up, ink on his fingers, oil-lamp light. An echo from the past: paint him solid and in full colour; the game tints echoes.

variants.when: His boss fight, as the Sovereign.
variants.change: change the look: robes and high collar lifted as if in a hot updraught, every ember edge burning bright with sparks, fine ember cracks across his skin.

name: Varkhul, the Hollow Knight
role: Brenna's father, Hollowed twelve years ago. Boss of Greywatch (A1-C6-01); unmasked, he dies asking to be remembered as a knight
look: Varkhul, the Hollow Knight: human (Hollowed), about 70, build tall, wide. No face shows: a closed great helm of blackened iron, its visor cracked down the middle, one burning ember-orange eye in the crack. Massive, tall shoulders. Collar: blackened full plate, ash grey at the edges, old and fine under the corruption, with a faded engraved crest on the breastplate; cracked seams leak a dull ember-orange glow; a ragged ash-grey surcoat and a tattered, scorched ash-grey cloak hang in strips. The shard in his greatsword hilt glows violet-black if the hilt is in frame. Keep their signature colours clear: ash, ember.
note: His face is hidden by the helm: show each expression through the burning eye in the visor's crack (narrowed, flaring, dimmed), the tilt of the head and the set of the shoulders.

variants.change: change the look: a grey-haired old man: stone-grey, dead-pale skin, a deeply lined gentle face, long wild silver hair, a short silver beard, amber eyes now clear; the armour split open with its ember light gone, a stained padded jack showing; at peace, dying.

name: Lord Severin Morvaine
role: The Blood Sovereign of Morvaine and Valencia's father. Act 2's villain, who blinds the sun with the Eye. Boss at A2-C4-04 and A2-C6-03; spared or killed; a prisoner in SQ3-Sunward
look: Lord Severin Morvaine: vampire (a Morvaine lord), centuries; looks about fifty, build tall, lean. Porcelain skin, bloodless; long, narrow, refined face, high cheekbones, long straight nose, thin lips in a polite, guarded line, clean-shaven; cool, heavy-lidded red eyes under finely arched silver brows. Silver hair falling straight to the shoulders under a circlet of black iron wrought into thorns. Collar: a long black velvet coat with a high collar lined in wine red and tarnished silver clasps; a wine-red waistcoat; a black cravat with a dark-red stone pin; a black velvet cape lined in wine red hanging from the shoulders. Keep their signature colours clear: black, wine red.

variants.change: change the look: the cape spread wide like a bat's wings with ragged points, fangs bared, blood-magic glow as an effect.
change the look: thin, grey stone-pale skin, no crown, lank silver hair, a plain stained linen shirt, iron cuffs, daylight on him.

name: Vorlaith, the Unmade King
role: An ancient thing that comes through the time-tear. Speaks four times in Act 3 (A3-C5-02, A3-C5-07); Act 4's threat
look: Vorlaith, the Unmade King: other (a being of living glass), ancient. A head of clear, colourless glass cracked with fine branching fractures, a cold white light drifting inside it like smoke in a bottle; smooth, calm, faintly amused features; two points of white light for eyes; no hair, only a faint glassy brow ridge. A crown of broken clock-hands, old dark iron and brass of different sizes, pointing every way. Collar: the same cracked glass forming a high collar and long, still robes, the light brightest in the chest. Keep their signature colours clear: colourless glass, white light.
note: The face is glass: show each expression in the glass features and in the light inside, which brightens, dims or flickers with the mood.

name: Lord Chancellor Vesper Crane
role: Lord Chancellor (his father stalled Greywatch's relief) and secretly the traitor paying in black-iron marks; his signet is the cube. A1-C4 to A2-C5; {sb} can use him (Heron's Due, the fast way) or execute him
look: Lord Chancellor Vesper Crane: human, about 50, build tall, very thin. Porcelain skin; long, narrow, refined face, high cheekbones, long straight nose, thin lips held in a polite, guarded line; cool, heavy-lidded grey eyes under finely arched black brows; a thin, precise black moustache. Glossy black hair slicked straight back. Collar: a floor-length plum coat, close at the chest, with a high standing collar, silver trim and a column of small silver buttons; a dark-grey waistcoat; a white stock at the throat. silver rings, one a signet set with a small black cube. Keep their signature colours clear: plum, silver.

name: Vesk
role: Severin's formal thrall-knight. Dies in A2-C1-02, coming apart into mist
look: Vesk: vampire thrall-knight, unknown, build big. Helm closed: black, with thin wine-red trim, shaped like a snarling wolf's head with the snout as the visor; two red points of light in the eye slits. Collar: full plate of glossy black steel, wine-red trim on every edge, sharp but elegant, layered black cloth between the plates; a black cape lined in wine red, ragged at the hem. Under the helm (never seen): porcelain skin, copper hair, red eyes. Keep their signature colours clear: black, wine red.
note: His face is hidden by the wolf helm: show each expression through the red eye lights (narrowed, flaring, dimmed) and the tilt of the head.

name: Vreya
role: Severin's sing-song thrall-knight. Leads the raid on the abbey (A2-C2-02)
look: Vreya: vampire thrall-knight, looks mid-twenties. Porcelain skin; heart-shaped face, small pointed chin, a mouth curled as if about to tease; sharp, bright red eyes under arched white brows; a few strands of white hair at the cheeks. An open-faced black helm with thin wine-red trim, crowned with a ring of tall, sharp points that frame the face. Collar: glossy black plate trimmed wine red, layered black cloth showing between the plates; a black cape lined in wine red. Keep their signature colours clear: black, wine red.

name: Mordain
role: Severin's whispering thrall-knight. Seen in Isadora's echo (A2-C3-03)
look: Mordain: vampire thrall-knight, unknown, build tall, thin. Helm closed: black, with thin wine-red trim, drawn out into a long, curved beak like a carrion bird's, with round red-glass eyepieces. Narrow shoulders. Collar: glossy black plate trimmed wine red, layered black cloth showing between the plates; a black cape lined in wine red. Under the helm (never seen): porcelain skin, copper hair, red eyes. Keep their signature colours clear: black, wine red.
note: His face is hidden by the beaked helm: show each expression through the red eyepieces' glow and the tilt of the head.

name: Bosun Grell
role: The Red Gulls' bosun, squeezing the Saltwind docks. The first fight, with {sb}'s blade at his throat (A1-C1-01)
look: Bosun Grell: Stoneborn (a short, very broad, sturdy mountain people), about 45, build stout, very wide. Tan, tar-stained skin; broad, blunt face, a thick brow ridge over small, hard brown eyes, a flattened nose broken more than once, a heavy square jaw; a thin pale scar through one brow and down the cheek; bald as an egg; a full, bushy copper beard. Almost no neck. Collar: an open raspberry-red bosun's coat with frayed cuffs, tar stains and tarnished brass buttons over an oatmeal shirt half unlaced; a steel hook strapped to the right wrist raised into frame. Keep their signature colours clear: Red Gull red.

name: Mother Gannet
role: Owns every door on Tallow Lane and is doubling the rents; changes Doomward marks for Crane's people. The antagonist of Kael's **A Name on a Door**
look: Mother Gannet: human, about 60, build wide. Fair skin; broad face, apple cheeks, broad nose, a wide mouth that smiles without warmth; shrewd brown eyes with crinkles. Silver hair under a small white lace cap pinned on top. Wide shoulders. Collar: a heavy mustard-yellow wool shawl pinned with a large brass brooch over a brown wool dress; ringed fingers holding a pen over a ledger. Keep their signature colours clear: mustard, brown.

name: Lord Harrow of Heronsgate
role: Holds the southern isles' fishing rights and once took Kettle Cove's nets. The antagonist of {sb}'s **The Heron's Due** (A1-C7)
look: Lord Harrow of Heronsgate: human, about 55. Fair skin; long, narrow, refined face, high cheekbones, long straight nose, thin lips; cool, heavy-lidded grey eyes looking slightly past the viewer; silver hair receding from the brow; silver side-whiskers. Collar: a long heron-green (deep grey-green) frock coat with a grey heron embroidered on the breast; a grey silk waistcoat; a white cravat. Keep their signature colours clear: heron green and grey.

name: Old Tomas
role: The Saltwind fisherman the Red Gulls bully (A1-C1-01). Speaks for the fishers in The Heron's Due; trainer (Netcaster); an Act 3 cameo
look: Old Tomas: human, about 70 (fifty years a fisherman). Tan, wind-burned skin; deeply lined, gentle face, drooping lids over kind sky-blue eyes, bushy white brows, big nose, hollowed cheeks, thin gentle mouth; white stubble. White hair under a snug, dark-blue knitted fisherman's cap rolled at the brim. Collar: a thick grey knitted jumper, darned, under a sleeveless mustard oilskin smock, cracked and patched.

name: Captain Odelle Marsh
role: Captain of the *Gull's Wager*, which carries you to Fable (P-04/P-05). Trainer (Deckhand) until she sails in Act 2
look: Captain Odelle Marsh: human, about 40. Deep umber skin; lean, strong face, firm jaw, straight nose, set mouth with a cheeky twist, small old scar on the chin; level brown eyes under straight brows; a small gold hoop in one ear. Black hair tied back in a tail under a weathered black tricorn with thin gold trim. Collar: a white linen shirt open at the neck, a fitted crimson waistcoat with brass buttons, a long charcoal sea-coat with the cuffs turned back.

name: Ruck
role: Odelle's bosun, who takes over Deckhand training in Act 2
look: Ruck: human, about 55. Brown skin; craggy lined face, deep-set grey eyes with crow's feet, thick brows, crooked nose, a nick through one brow; bald on the crown with a silver fringe; a silver goatee. Collar: a navy-and-cream striped knitted jersey with the sleeves pushed up, a sleeveless brown oilskin waistcoat, a rope lanyard.

name: Questmaster Fennick
role: Keeps the Lantern Market's quest board and posts the Mirewood contract (A1-C1-02)
look: Questmaster Fennick: human, about 45. Fair skin; round, pleasant face, soft cheeks, short nose, small contented smile; kind grey eyes with laugh lines behind small round spectacles; a neat silver moustache. Silver hair with a tidy side parting, a quill tucked behind one ear. Collar: an oatmeal shirt with black sleeve garters, a mustard-ochre waistcoat with a watch chain; ink-stained fingers.

name: Sergeant Brisk
role: Watch sergeant at the city gate (A1-C3). Gives side quest SQ-Tollroad
look: Sergeant Brisk: human, about 45. Brown skin; round, pleasant face gone tired, soft cheeks, short nose; brown eyes; a drooping black moustache. Black hair under an open-faced steel Watch helm with a brass rim and no crest. Collar: a navy Watch coat with brass buttons and a small brass lantern badge, a short navy cape with a brass clasp. Keep their signature colours clear: Watch navy and brass.

name: Pip the Potboy
role: The Gilded Flagon's potboy. Gives side quest SQ-Cellar (the black-eyed rats)
look: Pip the Potboy: Hearthling (a small, round-faced, child-sized folk), about 17, build small. Fair, freckled skin; smooth, eager face, soft jaw, straight nose a little big for it; wide-open brown eyes darting sideways. Short, messy copper hair. Small build. Collar: a cream shirt with rolled sleeves under a charcoal waistcoat; the bib of a long, stained leather apron.

name: Osric Penhallow
role: A cloth merchant in the Lantern Market. Gives side quest SQ-Ledger (a stolen green ledger with brass corners)
look: Osric Penhallow: human, about 45. Porcelain skin; round, pleasant face, soft cheeks, short nose; anxious brown eyes; a neat black moustache. Black hair with a careful side parting. Collar: a white shirt with full sleeves, an embroidered dusty-plum waistcoat (keep it dusty, away from Crane's plum), a tailor's tape round his neck, a short lavender cape with a small silver clasp.

name: Maud Tolley
role: The bellringer's widow on the jetty. Gives side quest SQ-Widow (her ring, engraved "Ring true", lost in the harbour shallows)
look: Maud Tolley: human, about 75. Fair skin; soft, round, kindly face with many fine wrinkles, small nose, sweet tired smile; gentle grey eyes in deep creases. Silver hair in a low bun. Collar: a plain grey-brown wool dress with a muted mauve-grey knitted shawl crossed over both shoulders; her late husband Edric's flat cap held to her chest.

name: Wren
role: A Low Ring pickpocket and one of Kael's crew: tries your belt in the Lantern Market, turns up in Kael's kitchen
look: Wren: Hearthling (a small, round-faced, child-sized folk), drawn child-sized, about 11, build small. Brown skin with freckles; round child's face, small snub nose, full cheeks, a quick, cheeky look; big bright amber eyes. Black hair scraped back into a scruffy short tail. Collar: an oatmeal shirt under a charcoal waistcoat far too big for her; a scrap of grey cloak round the shoulders; a coin walking across her knuckles.

name: Ranger Tamsin
role: A ranger of the Rangers' Lodge, which posted the Mirewood contract. Trainer (Lodge Ranger); a hawk rides on her shoulder
look: Ranger Tamsin: Wildkin (hawk), about 40. Tan skin; lean, strong face, firm jaw, straight nose, set mouth, small chin scar, a thin pale scar through one brow and down the cheek; level amber eyes. Two swept-back tufts of barred brown-and-cream feathers rise from the top of her head in place of ears. Chestnut hair pulled back tight. Collar: an olive ranger's coat with a moss-green collar over a forest-green leather jerkin and an oatmeal shirt; a short teal ranger's cloak; the Lodge's hawk on her shoulder (optional). Keep their signature colours clear: the Lodge's moss green.

name: Master Imra Vell
role: Master of the Proving Hall, who teaches the eight base classes
look: Master Imra Vell: Stoneborn (a short, very broad, sturdy mountain people), sixties. Deep umber skin; lean, strong face, firm jaw, a patient set mouth; a nose broken long ago, with an old scar across the bridge; level brown eyes. Black hair in a short pixie crop, well flecked with grey. Broad Stoneborn shoulders. Collar: a fitted, quilted fencing doublet in cream with navy panels and brass buckles down one side.

name: Hedda
role: A Doomward refugee mother at Thornbridge (A1-C3-01) who walked three weeks with her daughter Lise
look: Hedda: human (Doomward), about 40. Tan skin, gaunt with hunger; lean, strong face, firm jaw, straight nose, set mouth, small old chin scar; level brown eyes. Chestnut hair pulled back tight. Collar: an oatmeal shirt patched with sacking, a charcoal wool waistcoat, a coarse blanket worn round the shoulders as a cloak. "Sacking, charcoal and oat."

name: Lise
role: Hedda's daughter. Aged by the time-tear at Thornbridge in Act 3: "I'm forty-six... I was twelve on Tuesday" (Story/08-random-encounters.md:617)
look: Lise: human (Doomward), 12 (the aged variant is 46), build child. Tan skin with freckles; round child's face, small snub nose, full cheeks, a shy, wary look; big bright brown eyes. Chestnut hair in two plaits. Collar: an oversized oatmeal smock belted with rope, a small charcoal shawl round the shoulders; a rag doll held under her chin.

variants.when: Act 3, aged to forty-six overnight by the time-tear.
variants.change: change the look: a lean, strong adult face with a small chin scar, loose, unkempt chestnut hair, the child's smock tight on her, bewildered eyes.

name: Garrick
role: Caravan master on the road to Greywatch and the ford ambush (A1-C5-01)
look: Garrick: human, about 55. Tan, road-dusted skin; craggy lined face, crooked nose, a thin pale scar through one brow and down the cheek; deep-set brown eyes with crow's feet; a bushy black moustache. Black hair under a wide-brimmed tan felt hat with a braided cord band. Collar: an open, oiled-brown duster coat, a faded grey scarf against the road dust, a leather waistcoat over a grey shirt.

name: Hester Hollis
role: Pim Hollis's sister at Kestrel Ford, at the heart of Brannock's **Forty Letters**
look: Hester Hollis: human, late sixties. Porcelain skin; soft, round, kindly face with many fine wrinkles, small nose, sweet tired smile; gentle sky-blue eyes in deep creases. White hair in a low bun. Collar: a plain grey-brown wool dress with a soft heather knitted shawl crossed over both shoulders; a folded shawl held in her hands. Keep their signature colours clear: heather.

name: Tobin Ashgrove
role: Mira's father, a cider-presser from Orrin's Reach, found digging ditches in Doomward's levy (`mira-tobin`, part of The Ember Index)
look: Tobin Ashgrove: human, mid-fifties. Fair, freckled skin; round, pleasant face, soft cheeks, short nose; kind brown eyes with laugh lines; a short copper beard; thin copper hair, bald on the crown. Collar: an apple-green work shirt with rolled sleeves under the bib of a heavy, stained brown leather presser's apron. If his left hand shows: a wide old burn scar across its back. Keep their signature colours clear: apple green, brown.

variants.when: How you meet him, in the levy.
variants.change: change the look: a patched grey levy coat, mud everywhere, a rope belt, thinner and grimier, dazed.

name: Hobb
role: Boss of the woodcutters felling the last silverbark for the Admiralty, in Sera's **The Last Silverbark**
look: Hobb: human, about 50, build big. Fair, ruddy, freckled skin; craggy lined face, crooked nose, a nick through one brow; deep-set blue eyes with crow's feet; a full copper beard with sawdust in it. Copper hair under a dark-blue knitted cap. Big shoulders. Collar: a faded brown-and-ochre checked flannel shirt with rolled sleeves, a leather waistcoat, braces.

name: Pedlar Mags
role: A roadside pedlar with her donkey Duchess (`enc-mags`). Trainer (Wayfarer)
look: Pedlar Mags: unstated; Stoneborn, about 55. Tan, sun-browned skin; broad, weathered face, apple cheeks, broad nose, wide good-humoured mouth; crinkled brown eyes with deep laugh lines. Silver hair under a battered wide straw hat. Collar: a man's old green coat with deep pockets, a striped scarf, a smooth grey stone with a hole in it on a cord at the neck, pack-frame straps over the shoulders.

name: Pell
role: A Hollowmere lad whose sister went up to the blood-house. Gives side quest SQ-Pell (A2-C3-02); lives in Questeria in Act 3
look: Pell: human (the Morvaine valley), about 18. Porcelain, wind-chapped skin with freckles; smooth, eager face, soft jaw, straight nose a little big; wide-open brown eyes. Shaggy copper hair. Collar: a high-collared coat of dark grey wool buttoned to the chin, too thin for the weather; a black knitted scarf.

name: Ide
role: Pell's sister, kept as a "reserve" in the blood-house cellar; rescued in SQ-Pell
look: Ide: human (the Morvaine valley), about 22. Porcelain, very pale skin with shadows under the eyes; heart-shaped face, small pointed chin, a mouth about to say something tart; sharp, bright brown eyes under arched brows. Long, wild, tangled copper hair. Collar: a plain greyish linen shift with a dark wool shawl round the shoulders; a linen bandage inside one elbow if an arm shows.

name: Maren
role: Hollowmere's elder, who defends the blood Tithe (A2-C3-02)
look: Maren: human (the Morvaine valley), about 60. Porcelain skin; lean, sharp face, deep lines round the mouth, long nose, thin pressed lips; steady, piercing grey eyes under thin brows. White hair in a braided crown. Collar: a high-collared dark grey wool dress, a black wool shawl pinned with a pewter brooch; a small pewter cup on a chain.

name: Netty the Net-Mender
role: A net-mender on the harbour boardwalk; knows the Red Gulls' rackets
look: Netty the Net-Mender: human, about 55. Tan, freckled skin; broad, weathered face, apple cheeks, wide good-humoured mouth; crinkled green eyes. Silver hair in a braided crown. Collar: a cream blouse, a teal laced bodice-waistcoat.

name: Lark the Busker
role: The fountain busker who gives every new face a verse
look: Lark the Busker: Sylvan (a long-lived fantasy people with long, pointed ears), looks mid-twenties. Porcelain skin; narrow, sharp-featured face, high cheekbones, a knowing half-smile; keen hazel eyes. Pointed Sylvan ears; straight copper hair to the shoulders. Collar: a blush-pink shirt with billowing sleeves, a rose waistcoat, a short lavender cape with a silver clasp; a lute's neck over one shoulder.

name: Ilsa Fenwright
role: An apprentice of the Arcanum Spire, juggling scrolls for the guildhall
look: Ilsa Fenwright: human, about 24. Golden skin; open, likeable oval face, straight nose, friendly mouth; warm green eyes. Copper hair in a braid down the back. Collar: a cream blouse, a teal laced bodice-waistcoat; an armful of scrolls up to her chin.

name: Guardsman Oswin
role: Royal Guard on the palace terrace, who gossips about the King and the Princess who keeps riding out
look: Guardsman Oswin: human, about 24. Fair skin; open, likeable oval face, straight nose, steady blue eyes; copper hair under a polished steel helm with a gold-trimmed brim and a short navy plume. Collar: a navy tabard with a large gold sun over polished mail, steel pauldrons edged in gold, a white sash, an ochre-gold cloak.

name: Sister Hesper
role: A temple sister on the temple steps: the quiet bells, the bellringer who died
look: Sister Hesper: human, about 75. Deep umber skin; soft, round, kindly face with fine wrinkles, small nose, sweet tired smile; gentle brown eyes. Long, straight silver hair. Collar: a white blouse, an ochre tabard-tunic with a small gold sun embroidered on the chest, an ochre shawl.

name: Hessa the Barkeep
role: Barkeep of the Rusty Anvil, where Brannock drinks (A1-C4-05)
look: Hessa the Barkeep: Wildkin (bear), about 55, build big. Golden skin; broad, weathered face, apple cheeks, wide mouth; crinkled brown eyes; a thin pale scar through one brow and down the cheek. Two small, round, furry bear's ears on top of the head; black hair pulled back tight. Collar: a cream shirt with rolled sleeves, a charcoal waistcoat, the bib of a long, stained leather apron.

name: Old Aurek
role: An old orchard farmer among the Thornbridge refugees, one of the three sick that Mira's remedies go to (A1-C3)
look: Old Aurek: human (Doomward), about 70. Tan skin; deeply lined, gentle face, hollowed cheeks, big nose; kind grey eyes under bushy white brows. Bald, with wisps of white; a long white beard. Collar: a faded black wool coat with mismatched patches, a charcoal scarf, a blanket round the shoulders.

name: Teodor
role: The fevered young refugee at Thornbridge (A1-C3)
look: Teodor: human (Doomward), about 17. Brown skin, fever-flushed and sweaty; smooth young face, soft jaw; brown eyes; short, messy black hair; patchy stubble. Collar: a faded black patched wool coat, a charcoal scarf, a blanket round the shoulders; a tin cup.

name: Yselle the Glassblower
role: A refugee glassblower with burned hands at Thornbridge (A1-C3)
look: Yselle the Glassblower: Stoneborn (a short, very broad, sturdy mountain people), about 35, build stout. Golden, freckled skin with a smudge of ash across the cheek and brow; soft, round face, small kind mouth; amber eyes. Copper hair in a braid down the back. Collar: a blush-pink linen shirt with rolled sleeves, a teal waistcoat, a scorched leather apron bib; hands bandaged to the wrist in clean linen.

name: The recruit
role: A young winter recruit at the banners' call (A1-C7-01). Unnamed, but on 03's named-minor list
look: The recruit: human, about 17. Fair skin; smooth, eager face, soft jaw; wide blue eyes; gold hair under a plain steel kettle helm, a size too big and tipped back. Collar: a quilted navy gambeson with brass buttons, a grey woollen scarf, snow on the shoulders.

name: The Trader
role: Keeps the blue stall in Questeria's Lantern Market; sells potions, road gear and curios (Shops)
look: The Trader: human, about 45, plump. Olive skin; round, cheerful face, full cheeks, a waxed black moustache curled at the ends; bright, quick brown eyes. Dark curly hair under a soft sky-blue velvet cap with a short pheasant feather. Collar: a mustard silk shirt, a sky-blue brocade waistcoat with brass buttons, a cloth measuring tape hung round the neck.

name: The Smith of Halden's Forge
role: The smith at Halden's Forge in Questeria, who sells and mends arms (Shops)
look: The smith: human, about 40, broad and heavy-shouldered. Ruddy skin with smudges of soot on one cheek; square face, a broken nose, a short dark beard; steady grey eyes under heavy brows. Close-cropped dark hair. Collar: a sleeveless charcoal work shirt, the bib and straps of a scorched brown leather apron, a red neckerchief knotted at the throat.
mood: blunt, proud of the work, gruffly kind

name: The Chandler
role: Keeps the chandler's shop down by Questeria's south canal: candles, rope, lamp oil and sundries (Shops)
look: The Chandler: human, about 60, thin and upright. Pale, fine-lined skin; narrow face, a sharp nose with round wire spectacles on it, thin lips; pale blue eyes. Grey hair in a neat bun stuck through with a pencil. Collar: a high-necked cream blouse with a cameo brooch, a dark green knitted shawl, a ring of iron keys on a cord round the neck.

name: The Innkeeper
role: Keeps the inn in Questeria; sends you for the flower seller's rosewater (Questeria)
look: The innkeeper: human, about 55, stout. Rosy, weathered skin; round face, ruddy cheeks, a bushy grey moustache; twinkling hazel eyes. Bald on top with grey hair round the sides. Collar: a cream shirt with the collar open and sleeves rolled, a wine-red waistcoat, a checked linen towel thrown over one shoulder.

name: The Spice Seller
role: Keeps the teal spice stall in Questeria, and the apothecary's shelf while her sister's away (Shops)
look: The spice seller: human, about 30. Warm brown skin; oval face, high cheekbones, a small gold nose stud, a wide smile; dark, lively eyes lined with kohl. Black hair wrapped in a teal headscarf hung with small gold coins along its edge; gold hoop earrings. Collar: a saffron-yellow blouse, a teal shawl embroidered with gold leaves.

name: The Flower Seller
role: Sells flowers from a cart at the bottom of the Lantern Market; owes the innkeeper rosewater (Questeria)
look: The flower seller: human, about 20. Fair, freckled skin; heart-shaped face, a small nose, pink cheeks; soft green eyes. Strawberry-blonde hair in a loose side braid with a white daisy tucked in, a straw sun hat pushed back on the head. Collar: a pink cotton dress with a square neck, the bib of a cream apron, a sprig of lavender pinned at the chest.

name: The Lookout
role: The Gull's Wager's lookout, who sees the sea-wraiths first (P-05)
look: The lookout: human, about 19, wiry. Sun-browned skin; long face, a sunburnt nose, a gap in his front teeth; wide blue eyes. Wind-tangled sandy hair under a knitted navy watch cap. Collar: a cream-and-navy striped sailor's shirt, a salt-stained short canvas jacket, a brass spyglass on a strap across the chest.

name: Red Gull Thug
role: A Red Gull enforcer shaking down Old Tomas on the docks (A1-C1)
look: A Red Gull thug: human, about 30, heavy-set. Tan skin; blunt face, a crooked broken nose, three days' stubble, a small scar on the lip; hard, narrow dark eyes. Greasy dark hair under a knotted blood-red bandana with a grey gull feather stuck in it. Collar: a sleeveless red-dyed leather jerkin over a dirty undyed shirt, a brass knuckle-duster hung on a cord at the neck.

name: Royal Messenger
role: Princess Elara's messenger, who brings you to the Gilded Flagon (A1-C4)
look: The royal messenger: human, about 22, slight. Fair skin; boyish face, a pointed chin, freckles; anxious light-brown eyes. Neat brown hair in a short bob under a navy cap with a gold sun badge. Collar: a navy-and-gold royal livery tabard with a gold sun on the chest, a short navy shoulder cape, the strap of a leather dispatch satchel across the chest.

name: Royal Guard
role: Guards the Sunspire's great hall door; Princess Elara's guard, officially (A1-C4)
look: A royal guard: human, about 45, solid. Tan skin; square, weathered face, a short greying beard; patient grey eyes. A polished steel helm with cheek guards and a navy plume, a little hair showing at the temples. Collar: a steel gorget and the top of a breastplate edged in gold, a navy cloak fastened with a gold sun clasp.
